notes.title: V1.3: Fixed misleading LD
notes.content:
We have fixed some misleading level design issues and features:
* The entrance of the cave was blocked at the time you discovered the cavern. Once discovered, the entrance would get cleared out. It was actually there to help you in case you fell into the cavern without a jetpack.
* Now you need to fill your radioactive canister with uranium to fix the generator. :)

notes.title: Hotfix v1.01 - Death Menu Fix
notes.content:
Hello Astronauts!

We fixed the issue with the death menu freezing input, so now you can die in the game without a hitch! No need to finish the game in one life anymore!

In the meantime, the "Quit" button in the pause menu will take you back to the main menu (instead of quitting the game).

Hope you have a better experience!

Your Wondersoft Team.

notes.title: Art Improvements and Procedural Terrain in SISING
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to share some updates on the development of SISING, our survival space digger game.

[h1]Art by Wile3D[/h1]

Our environment artist, Wile3D, has reworked the world of SISING. These improvements are part of our ongoing effort to deliver a high-quality, immersive experience. You can see more of their work in the images below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/26762d33650450be1301e688341c86a4d1742bf5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/80ab1964754f6ce4a771157089d52ea73f4ecd4f.png[/img]

[h1]Procedurally Generated Terrain[/h1]

I’ve also been experimenting with Signed Distance Fields (SDF) and procedurally generated terrain in Unreal Engine 5. This technology allows us to create dynamic and varied environments, making each playthrough unique.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/ff03b1ecc7ea58bb2e80746e93eccdcf53d4fda8.gif[/img]


[h1]SOMA-Like Atmosphere[/h1]

One of our biggest inspirations for SISING is the game SOMA. We’re striving to create a similar atmosphere dark, immersive, and thought-provoking. To achieve this, we’re focusing on diegetic UI elements and subtle storytelling through the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/3824f3e38a7a77242daead9bbf1b4be77b468a3d.png[/img]

However, as a tiny team, we’ve had to make some concessions along the way. But we’re determined to deliver a memorable experience that stays true to our vision.
What’s Next?


We’re still in development, but we’re making steady progress. If you’d like to support us and follow our journey, don’t forget to [b]wishlist SISING and follow for regular updates[/b].

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Devlog Update: Diegetic Menus
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re still hard at work on the game, and we’ve made some great strides thanks to our playtesters feedback. The first playtests showed that the game was a bit too challenging, so we’ve been tweaking the difficulty to make it more enjoyable for everyone.

Right now, we have about 20 minutes of gameplay ready for you to explore. But, most important, [b]we’ve also added diegetic (skeuomorphic) menus[/b] to keep you fully immersed in the world. These menus are integrated into the environment, making the experience feel more natural and seamless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/d1273378cb5f3d29f50f87e6c8f5bf5c676e6c99.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565401/eec3d9c9dced2b5f05981b323020743fffd7df46.png[/img]


And here’s a little secret: we’ve improved the ending, but we won’t spoil it for you. You’ll have to play to find out! 😉

Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more updates!
